title: Ordinary unit cohomology transport across a cartesian square
statement: Let $k\to k'$ be an algebra map of commutative rings, $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $h$ display $C'$ as the cartesian base change with projections $\iota'$ and $f'$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. For $n\ge0$ and unit modules $O_C,O_{C'}$ there is a $k'$-linear equivalence $t:HOver(f',O_{C'},n)\simeq HOver(f_{k'},(O_C)_{k'},n)$ for the structural scalar actions [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. For every $x\in HOver(f,O_C,n)$, applying $t$ to its ordinary structural pullback along $\iota'$ (invImage, inverse constIso and the coefficient map adjoint to $O_C\to\iota'_*O_{C'}$) gives $H.baseChangeLinear(f,O_C,n)(x)$. This concerns only ordinary cohomology; there is no etale sheaf, compactness, separatedness or flatness hypothesis.

source.place: cohomology-equation-functorial; Tag 02KH, coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology, untensored map construction; Mathlib Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/PullbackFree.lean, pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit

proof.text: Use h.isoPullback.hom and its second projection identity. Form the real linear map L from categorical-base-change cohomology to displayed unit cohomology using the ordinary pullbackObjUnitIso and the structural unit map.
Apply bijectivity of specified unit-cohomology transport along the scheme isomorphism to L, then form the inverse LinearEquiv.ofBijective L hb.
Apply injectivity of the forward equivalence to the desired inverse-transport identity. Its inverse cancels; the remaining identity is exactly the forward cartesian cohomology composition theorem.

proof_origin.place: Explicit forward cohomology map, inversion of its bijectivity, and the composition identity; second reading by N4.
